chunks: ʿAbd al-Aʿlā, the mawlā of Āl Sām, asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
How much was the length of the Mosque of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم?
He said: “It was three thousand and six hundred cubits, measured in total area.”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: A kunyah of Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.ذِرَاعٍ: A cubit, a unit of measurement
key_terms.طُولُ: The measurement or extent being asked about
key_terms.عَبْدُ الْأَعْلَى: The narrator who asked the Imam
key_terms.مَسْجِدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: The mosque of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: How large was the Mosque of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith records a question to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام about the measured size of the Mosque of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم. It preserves a historical detail about the Prophet’s mosque and reflects transmitted knowledge concerning its dimensions.
